principle: Share proven engines/components and patterns; do not create a premature monolithic framework or shared state database across all products.

assets.reuse_rule: Reuse/adapt notebook document and editor patterns. Datapass remains the primary notebook product.
Common coding editor pattern; product state stays separate.
Share React Flow mechanics only. Do not share one universal Airflow/Data Factory/Mapping Data Flow schema.
Primary FactoryLab lower-layer candidate. Prefer adapter/runner integration first; fork only if a measured adapter limitation blocks required UX/evidence.
One bounded Spark service with different product depth/exposure.
Canonical Fabric-semantic/control API seed. If Duckle integration succeeds, do not grow it into a duplicate generic ETL engine.
Contoso owns generation; other products consume exported fixtures/scenarios.
Extract dbt/model/chart assets to Contoso and Fabric pipeline donor assets to FactoryLab before removing/hiding them from Datapass.

avoid: one shared mutable workspace database across all four products
one universal graph schema for Airflow, Data Factory and data flows
duplicating dbt platform code in Datapass and CaseLab
duplicating Contoso data generation inside every product
claiming simulation equals the external cloud engine
